query: select now() as db_now,now()>i.expires_at as naturally_expired,i.id,i.status,i.auth_ready,i.email as invitation_email,i.role,i.clinic_id,i.invited_by,i.accepted_by,i.accepted_at,i.expires_at,encode(extensions.digest(i.token,'sha256'),'hex') as token_digest,u.id as recipient_id,u.email as auth_email,u.email_confirmed_at,u.deleted_at is null as auth_not_deleted,(u.banned_until is null or u.banned_until<=now()) as auth_not_banned,(select p.status::text from public.profiles p where p.id=u.id) as profile_status,(select p.deleted_at is null from public.profiles p where p.id=u.id) as profile_not_deleted,(select count(*) from public.clinic_members m where m.user_id=u.id) as membership_count,(select count(*) from public.clinics c where c.owner_id=u.id) as owned_clinic_count from public.clinic_invitations i join auth.users u on u.id='979d0bea-07c7-470f-b188-9c029d1a0701' where i.id='dd2f9c40-705c-42b8-b39a-4f04e4e9b7f7'
